Chases($x, $y, bool) ::: Does x chase y?
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Kind($x, bool) ::: Is x kind?

Eats(Squirrel, Lion, True) ::: The squirrel eats the lion.

Round($x, True) >>> Sees($x, Cat, True) ::: If something is round then it sees the cat.

Chases($x, BaldEagle, True) && Young($x, True) >>> Chases($x, Squirrel, True) ::: If something chases the bald eagle and it is young then it chases the squirrel.
Eats($x, Squirrel, True) && Eats($x, Cat, True) >>> Chases(Squirrel, Cat, True) ::: If something eats the squirrel and it eats the cat then the squirrel chases the cat.
Round($x, True) >>> Eats($x, BaldEagle, True) ::: If something is round then it eats the bald eagle.

Round(BaldEagle, True) ::: The bald eagle is round.
